title: The Star That Blinks Like a Beacon and Scares Astronomers
hook: A star 1,400 light-years away dims by 97% every 30 days, and no natural explanation survives scrutiny.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines the promise of alien technology with a real astronomical mystery that refuses to be solved.

title: The Lost NASA Tape That Contains a Warning from the Void
hook: In 1977, a radio telescope recorded a signal so powerful it should have ended the search for aliens — then the tape disappeared.
why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into the conspiracy-lover's dream: a suppressed message from space erased by the government.

title: The Planet Where It Rains Glass Sideways at 5,000 km/h
hook: An exoplanet where the atmosphere is so hostile that glass droplets fly horizontally fast enough to shred a spacecraft.
why_this_can_go_viral: Shockingly vivid imagery of a nightmare world that feels like science fiction but is real.

title: The Asteroid That Will Hit Earth and No One Is Watching
hook: There's a asteroid large enough to destroy a city that we won't see until it's days away because it comes from the Sun's direction.
why_this_can_go_viral: Exploits a terrifying gap in planetary defense that most people don't know exists.

title: The Signal That Came from a Dead Star and Made No Physical Sense
hook: A pulsar's signal changed its rhythm in a way that violates the laws of physics — and it happened for 16 minutes.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea that a natural object broke physics creates immediate curiosity and fear.

title: The Classified Soviet Space Cannon That Fired in Orbit
hook: In the 1980s, the USSR launched a cannon into space, fired it, and then erased every record of what happened.
why_this_can_go_viral: Hidden military space tech triggers both conspiracy excitement and 'forbidden history' appeal.

title: The Star That Is Disappearing Into Its Own Gravity Hole
hook: A star is collapsing into a black hole so slowly that we are the first humans to ever witness a star die in real time.
why_this_can_go_viral: Witnessing the universe 'in surgery' is inherently gripping and existentially heavy.

title: The Dark Matter Cloud That Will Annihilate the Earth in 500 Years
hook: A massive dark matter filament is on a collision course with the solar system, and when it arrives, matter may cease to exist.
why_this_can_go_viral: Paints dark matter as an active, impending threat rather than a passive mystery.

title: The Planet That Has No Atmosphere and Should Be Dead — But Isn't
hook: A naked rocky world without an atmosphere somehow shows signs of dynamic surface change, hinting at unknown processes.
why_this_can_go_viral: Defies logic and invites questions about what else we might be wrong about.

title: The Gamma Ray Burst That Will Hit Earth Any Century Now
hook: A binary star system is aiming a gamma ray burst directly at us, and we have no way to predict the exact moment.
why_this_can_go_viral: Turns a known cosmic event into an existential countdown clock, which is terrifyingly addictive.

title: The Secret Space Shuttle That Flew for Two Years and Nobody Knows Why
hook: The US military launched a space plane that stayed in orbit for 718 days, and the official mission statement is blank.
why_this_can_go_viral: Secrecy + space + military = a viral recipe that feeds on distrust and curiosity.

title: The Void That Sucked a Galaxy Dry in 100 Million Years
hook: A supermassive black hole is consuming an entire galaxy so fast that the galaxy will vanish before our eyes on cosmic timescales.
why_this_can_go_viral: The scale is almost incomprehensible, making it perfect for existential dread content.

title: The Dwarf Planet That Has a Ring and It Defies Every Orbital Rule
hook: A tiny dwarf planet at the edge of the solar system has a ring that should have collapsed billions of years ago.
why_this_can_go_viral: A small world doing something impossible challenges our fundamental understanding of physics.

title: The NASA Experiment That Accidentally Opened a Portal to Another Dimension
hook: A NASA experiment with quantum entanglement produced an anomaly that some scientists interpreted as a dimensional bridge.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines real science with the forbidden-fruit thrill of 'they opened a door they shouldn't have.'

title: The Star That Turns Off and On Like a Light Switch
hook: A star dims by 100% for days at a time, then reignites — and no known stellar process can explain it.
why_this_can_go_viral: The visual of a star turning off feels like a glitch in the simulation — pure viral bait.

title: The Black Hole That Is Older Than the Big Bang According to One Math Error
hook: A black hole candidate has a redshift suggesting it's older than the universe itself, and the data has never been refuted.
why_this_can_go_viral: Threatens the entire timeline of cosmology, which is deeply unsettling yet fascinating.

title: The Hidden Planet That Hurled a Comet at Earth 65 Million Years Ago
hook: A hypothetical Planet Nine may have kicked a comet into the inner solar system that ended the dinosaurs.
why_this_can_go_viral: Ties an existing conspiracy (Planet Nine) to a real mass extinction event — powerful narrative.

title: The Signal That Turned a Radio Telescope Into a Bomb
hook: A mysterious signal received at Arecibo caused a power surge that damaged the dish, and the source was never identified.
why_this_can_go_viral: Sounds like a weaponized alien signal — a sci-fi horror trope made real.

title: The Dead World Where Life Evolved, Then Died, and Left Its Bones
hook: A planet with the chemical fingerprints of past life now orbits a dead star as a frozen tomb of a lost biosphere.
why_this_can_go_viral: A graveyard planet is both poetic and horrifying, tapping into deep existential curiosity.

title: The Government Facility That Tracks Every Object That Enters the Solar System
hook: A secret US base in the Pacific monitors every asteroid, comet, and anomalous object — and sometimes what they find goes unreported.
why_this_can_go_viral: Implies the government knows about threats they hide from the public — pure conspiracy gold.

title: The Supernova That Almost Killed All Life on Earth 2.6 Million Years Ago
hook: A supernova exploded so close to Earth that it stripped the atmosphere and kicked off an ice age — and it could happen again.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea that a star could have ended us without warning is terrifying and historically real.

title: The Rogue Asteroid That Has a Moon Made of Gold
hook: An interstellar asteroid carries a metallic moon rich in precious metals worth quadrillions — and it's passing near Earth soon.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines greed, danger, and the allure of untold wealth — a cosmic treasure hunt with stakes.

title: The Dark Matter Clump That Is Warping Our Galaxy's Spin
hook: A massive dark matter concentration is pulling the Milky Way's stars off their predicted orbits, and we cannot see what it is.
why_this_can_go_viral: The invisible hand of dark matter literally bending our galaxy — perfect for cosmic horror content.

title: The Quasar That Flickered Out and Left a Vacuum Behind
hook: A quasar that was one of the brightest objects in the universe suddenly shut off, and the void it left is growing.
why_this_can_go_viral: The sudden death of a cosmic monster feels like a mystery that might signal something worse.
